title: cordless vacuum
text: cordless vacuum. I purchased this as a trial... I have always purchased the way more expensive brand - but wanted to try this. First it's a fraction of the price.  And it is VERY lightweight - could be a good thing, maybe not.. So I was worried - and because I was used to the much more expensive brand, it took a few minutes to sort out how to use it, turn it on, hang on the wall charger and even to empty it.  I will honestly say, it doesn't really suck as strongly as the much more expensive brand - but it does enough I think for the price - my opinion anyway.  As long as you remember you mostly get what you pay for, this is fine.  And of course time will tell and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
